limitations: No claim that all Worst15 losses are fixed; only two compiler optimization changes earned.
Low-power native corpus ranks are provisional; do not treat three-sample bootstrap intervals as reliable coverage.
Callgrind uses bounded sizes, including startup and libraries; it is a different ranking from full-size native runtime.
Loop-density auto-selection compares potentially different phases; its ratios are not accepted as performance evidence.
The result-cast and promoted-literal cases include IR proof-boundary witnesses, not newly observed frontend-C miscompilations.
